gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-batak: Tiled, techy, unmistakably futuristic. Noto Sans Batak is the sturdiest thing here: a towering x-height and a wide-open e that never squeezes shut.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-choras: Ornate lettering with a pronounced x-height leads, while Noto Sans Chorasmian follows in a plain sans with curves that stop short of closing. Literary on top, contemporary below.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic is a modern sans-serif with a welcoming gap in the c, and capitals that sit barely above its lowercase. Audiowide's tiled, monoline futurism rides over it without a fight.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Almendra Display has letters that never seem to pinch shut, giving it an ornate, bookish warmth. And Noto Sans Coptic does the opposite job, a clean sans-serif whose middle zone dominates every line.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Noto Sans Buginese reads open and modern, like chalk arcs left unjoined. Audiowide does its best work with a monoline skeleton and tile-like glyphs, while the body font keeps its short ascenders quietly out of the way.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-cuneif: Noto Sans Cuneiform reads clean and contemporary, its e opening up and its lowercase swollen like glass beads. Almendra Display counters with ornate, literary letters, and next to that sans the two feel like a manuscript beside a clear window.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Audiowide keeps its curves as thick as a drawn thread, with glyphs set like tiles and a futuristic tilt. Noto Sans Chakma matches it with a plain sans that packs lowercase up toward the caps.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-desere: Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. Noto Sans Deseret is a approachable sans-serif with open apertures and a wide-looking lowercase, so a modest size for the body lets it sit comfortably under the ornate heading.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads approachable, a tall band of letters under short stalks, with a wide gap at the e terminal. And Audiowide supplies a steady, pressure-free line with a futuristic edge, where the plain sans body handles the quiet work.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-devana: Ornate, bookish, never pinched. Noto Sans Devanagari is the modern counterweight, a sans-serif with an open-curved g and a compact skyline where capitals melt into lowercase.
